title: Ultra-realistic cinematic disaster scene in a modern city, a brave young woman…

Damaged skyscrapers, city buses, shattered glass, dust clouds, dramatic golden-hour sunlight, volumetric lighting, intense atmosphere, realistic textures, dynamic composition, shallow depth of field, 8K photorealism, cinematic color grading, high-detail movie still, vertical.
